decision_basis: Every bounded-wildcard partition retained every fresh adjacent literal stable ID under strict two-pass complete capture. Every wildcard-only record, if any, passed an intended-concept review. Every event retained both mandatory screenshots.

translation.wildcard_atom: NOFT(token or ordered phrase using the smallest safe bounded [*n])
translation.wildcard_scope: Every declared variant family with one safe common source stem. Singleton, punctuation, and unsafe-stem alternatives remain literal.

compound_blocks.G_model: G_model_fixed OR G_mission_exact OR (G_mission AND M_B)
compound_blocks.G_structure: G_structure_fixed OR G_product_exact OR G_variation OR (G_product AND M_B)

controls.database: exactly one allowed PQDT Global database label
controls.screenshots: automatic configured search-page and first results-page PNGs beside every JSON

source_artifact_boundary: Marker-bound strict adapter artifacts remain isolated pilot evidence. The pilot assessment and all derived unions are nonmergeable and are not final-search inputs.

source_window.cutoff_handling: Retain 2026 records for later screening against the exact diagnostic cutoff.

limitations: PQDT YR has year precision. Records dated 2026 still require screening against the exact 2026-08-29 diagnostic cutoff.
LA(English) is metadata evidence. Full-report language remains a screening decision.
Degree subtype, completion, access, and full-text availability remain screening decisions.
The source wildcard may match suffixes within each declared bound. Wildcard-only records require explicit intended-concept review.
